svg.title: The same plan twice: once kept on time, once worked back from a vision.
svg.desc: The same three pieces of work, drawn twice as a small schedule. In the first row, a coordinator keeps every piece on time, and a note where the plan ends asks: toward what? In the second row, a concept champion runs the same schedule, and where the plan ends stands the vision, highlighted. A dotted path runs back from the vision to the start of the work: name the destination, then work back from it.
svg.text: names the destination, then works back
